status: Proposed concern contributions. Targets and achieved benefit are unresolved.
scope: Pre-Phase A through adapted C covers models and declared host software. Physical, operational and target qualification benefits are outside scope.
interpretation: The forward table lists every contributing concern ID for each MOE. Descendant and alias IDs remain explicit occurrences. Aliases share observations with their referenced concerns. Links describe bounded contributions and preserve the causal hierarchy. They do not assert satisfaction or automatically inherit every parent link. Monetary burden is separate from person-hours. External concerns contribute to clear exclusions and evidence gaps.
